statement: For the actual based null-homotopic plane loop, the actual boundary-quotient family with exactly two lifted fibre partitions has an intrinsic based contraction commuting with every original operator preserving the open orbit. It simultaneously intertwines every boundary quotient with the natural one-dimensional median contraction, retaining source and target covering labels.
depends_on: C27 line-median naturality; C29 ambient circle winding; C31 inverse median identity; C42 actual boundary quotient; C43 connected lifted fibres; C45 exact two-quotient domains
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), infinite-operator zero-level comparison; simultaneous boundary relations in C12
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The theorem concerns the actual two-element set of lifted fibre partitions, not merely a chosen pair from a larger set.
notes: The three explicit coordinate-pair groups of C45 are preserved by the coordinatewise running median. An operator h commuting with the loop and preserving O satisfies J_hx=J_x; choosing a_h x=hx gives a_h in N_L(J) and the exact pullback formula Phi_z h=Phi_(a_h z), so it permutes the full family of partitions. Every operator lift therefore has a coordinate-pair or exchanged-coordinate form. Based covering uniqueness proves that it commutes with the lifted loop, and median naturality proves commutation with the contraction. Deck maps are included. Every other boundary quotient in the family is an exact target reparametrization of one selected coordinate. No continuity across the ambient frontier, no statement for a one-element family, and no preservation of a third independent quotient is inferred.
